prompt: Loop a Matcher with find() to collect EVERY hashtag in a post into a list, lowercased and without the '#', then count how many are distinct.
explanation: find() scans forward for the next match and returns false once the text runs out, so a while loop over it visits every occurrence in order. The capturing group around the tag body is what lets group(1) return the name without the '#' that anchored the match. Requiring a letter first ([A-Za-z] before the repeated class) is what makes #1bad fail, and a HashSet gives the distinct count for free because it discards repeats.
hints: The pattern is "#([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)" -- the group excludes the '#' from what you collect.
Create the Matcher once and drive it with a while (m.find()) loop, adding the lower-cased group 1 of each match to the list.
For countUnique, pass the list to a new HashSet<>(...) and return its size().
